text: I am fully convinced that majority of bisexual women, myself included, would much rather be dating women over men but we just, for the life of us, cannot make it out of those freaking DMs. Women will ghost you like no other. A man could never ghost you in the ways in which a woman can. I can't even count how many times I've been genuinely interested in pursuing a girl and, you know, things seem like they're going great, we're talking, we're texting, you know, all that and then they just ghost you on a random Wednesday. And you need- I- we didn't even get to hang out. They just vanish. Poof. Never to be heard from again. Genuinely, I don't know how women are getting into relationships with other women because I can't even find one who, like, wants to hang out with me. How are you guys finding relationships and love? This is funny on so many levels. Honestly, it's like watching an emotional Ouroboros, the snake that is itself. The funniest part is that she probably doesn't even realize how ironic she sounds. She starts by saying that most bisexual women, including herself, would much rather date women over men which, let's be real, is the usual soft implication that men are the problem. Men are exhausting, men are disappointing, men lack emotional intelligence, you know the script. And then, immediately after that, she spends the entire video explaining how women ghost her harder than any man ever has. So the message becomes, men are bad, I'd rather date women, but dating women is somehow even worse. You can't make this up. And here's the kicker. I can almost guarantee she's doing the exact same thing to countless men in her DMs. Ignoring messages, leaving guys undelivered, giving them hope, and then disappearing. The hypocrisy is wild, but it seems like she doesn't even realize it. And then, these same women will tell you how men have it easy, how dating is so much better for guys, how women are the ones who struggle. Meanwhile, she's literally describing how difficult it is to get a single woman to commit to plans. Welcome to the average man's dating life, miss.
